spans.s:
झणझणायते /jhaṇajhaṇāyate/ 

jhanajhaņāyate klingt, klirrt, rasselt / jingles, rattles,
jhanajjhaạita- klingend, jhaņajhaņā-ravāḥ m. plur. Geklingel, prākr. jhanajjhanaë, nepālī jhanjhanā unu klingeln: Onomatopoetisch wie jhanati und jhanatkāra-liha mkāraḥ. S. chanacchan.

झणति /jhaṇati/ 

ihanati klingt / sounds, Schallwort. S. das Vorhergehende.
